title: Business engine
subtitle: Persistent business workspace. Integration labels show configured modes; a live receipt or dated verification is needed to establish provider readiness.
connectionHint: Use the local operator credential from your private project recovery file. It stays in memory for this tab.
disabled: The local engine URL is not configured for this frontend build.
pending: Request accepted. Check the booking status before treating it as confirmed.
saved: Saved and verified through the engine.
bookingConfirmed: Your appointment is confirmed by the calendar.
bookingRescheduled: Your appointment has been rescheduled by the calendar.
bookingCancelled: Your appointment has been cancelled by the calendar.
removePrompt: Remove this document from active answers?
redactTranscriptPrompt: Clear this ended call's local transcript? This does not remove provider copies or backups.
redactTranscriptDone: Local transcript cleared. Provider copies and older backups still need separate deletion.
acoustic: Voice acceptance is tracked separately from synthetic business evaluations.
unavailable: Engine connection failed. Previously displayed records may be stale.
connectionDisabled: Local engine connection is not configured.
configuredOnly: Configuration only; this label does not prove a live connection.
captureDelivery: Captured locally; no external email was sent.
externalDelivery: External transport accepted the message; confirm inbox delivery separately.
unknownDelivery: Delivery mode was not recorded for this historical job. Check its receipt and external inbox.
